name: Burak Yilmaz
bio:
Burak's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. After years managing high-end restaurants in Istanbul, a chance encounter with a team principal led to an opportunity to elevate the dining experience for the Aston Martin team. He saw it as a new challenge, a chance to bring Michelin-star quality cuisine to the demanding environment of the racetrack. 

Burak is known for his meticulous planning and creative menu designs, ensuring that the team is not only well-fed but also energized by nutritious and delicious meals. He believes that a happy and healthy team is a winning team, and he takes immense pride in contributing to their success. His ability to adapt to the ever-changing schedules and logistical complexities of motorsport events is a testament to his dedication and experience.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Burak is a stocky man with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Insists on using only fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, even when traveling internationally.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down new menu ideas inspired by his surroundings.
Has a habit of humming Turkish folk songs while preparing meals.
